description: The 2026-10-08 seventeen-repository integration roster is reconciled with the active Standards authority registry and newer systems. No role is silently promoted by inclusion.
evidenceRules: GitHub source, CI workflow result, public website, receipt, and physically observed execution are distinct claim classes.
Private repository source URLs must not be publicized.
Historical/optional entries are not automatically current canonical authority.
No arbitrary word overlap is sufficient to attach evidence to a repository.
